pre.text: ✅ Directions : You will be listening to 8 ATC instructions. Each one asks you to do **more than read back.** Your callsign is HL123. "Say again (=Repeat)" available once only. * Response time for each question : 30 seconds or less

body.text: Your slot at Rothbury closes at 1150Z and it is now 1131Z. You want to know what the holding will cost you.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, descend to 7,000 feet, expect one zero minutes of holding at VARDO.
Give a full readback, and inquire what the holding will do to your arrival time.
VARDO

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, cross VARDO at or above one one thousand.
Give a full readback, and tell him what you can do instead.
You cannot hold Mach decimal eight two at your present weight. The best you can do is Mach decimal seven eight.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, climb to flight level three five zero, increase speed to Mach decimal eight two for sequence.
Give a full readback, and make a request with a reason.
On the taxi out you saw a large flock of birds sitting on the grass beside the runway two four threshold. You were busy with the checklist and have not reported it.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, line up and wait runway two four.
Give a full readback, and report what you saw.
You need de-icing before departure and you do not know whether the de-icing bay on taxiway Golf is in use today. You want to be told before you get there.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, taxi to holding point Kilo two via Golf, hold short of runway one six.
Give a full readback, and make a request with a reason.

You have a passenger with chest pain in row 14. You want an ambulance to meet you at the stand and you want the shortest taxi in. You have already reported the medical case to Approach — that is what his "roger" answers — but he does not yet know what you want.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, turn left heading zero niner zero, descend to 5,000 feet, vectors for Rothbury.
Give a full readback, and say your intentions.
You called Ground for taxi a minute ago. You will not be ready for one five minutes — the cabin crew are still re-seating passengers away from the overwing exits.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, hold position. Report when you are ready to taxi, I have two inbounds for the stand next to you.
Give a full readback, acknowledge his situation, and tell him how long you need.

Your anti-ice has been on for two zero minutes and the airframe is clear. You are presently in light rain at zero degrees. You reported light icing to the previous sector one zero minutes ago and Approach has been told — he is asking you for an update.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, descend to 4,000 feet. Two things — say your icing condition, and say whether you need a higher speed on the approach.
Give a full readback, and answer both of his questions.

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In each question you are given your own figure and the controller gives you two choices. **Decide, say why, and give him the figure you need.** Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 30 seconds or less

body.text: Rothbury / Caldon

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Rothbury runway two four has 2,600 metres but you'd be one eight minutes to touchdown. Caldon is seven minutes away with 3,400 metres. What would you like?
Your required landing distance today is 2,450 metres. You have no reason to be in a hurry.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, runway one six has work in progress — 2,700 metres from the displaced threshold. Runway three four has the full 3,100, but you'd be number four, about one zero minutes.
Your required landing distance today is 3,100 metres.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Penhale runway two seven has 2,800 metres and it's five minutes away. Minsterly has 3,600 metres but it's two two minutes. Which one do you want?
You are heavy today. With the flaps you have out, **the slowest speed you can hold is two two zero knots.**

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, reduce speed to one niner zero knots until six miles. Can you do that?
**Your maximum crosswind on a wet runway is two five knots.** The runway is wet. You are holding short of runway two four, ready for departure.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, runway two four, wind one eight zero at three zero, gusting three five. Runway one six is dry with wind one eight zero at one two, but it's eight minutes of taxi back. Say your intentions.

You have been in moderate turbulence at flight level three three zero for the last one five minutes. The aircraft ahead reported it smooth at flight level two niner zero. You want to descend to flight level two niner zero.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, do you want to stay at three three zero, or do you want to come down?

sections.title: 약점 C. 값 유지 — 되묻기 롤플레이 (신규 최우선)

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In Part C you will be interacting with an Air traffic controller through nine turns. **The controller will ask you for the same figures again later in the scenario.** Follow the prompts and respond as necessary. "Say again (=Repeat)" available only once. Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 30 seconds or less

Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, descending through flight level one niner zero for one three thousand, 45 miles from KELSO, inbound to Rothbury Airport. Your fuel endurance is two hours zero five minutes and there are one eight four persons on board. Your required landing distance is 2,450 metres, and at today's weight the slowest speed you can hold is two one zero knots.

body.text: Contact Rothbury Approach and report your position and level.
KELSO TWO arrival
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and inquire about the braking action.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Rothbury Approach, descend to one one thousand, expect the KELSO TWO arrival, ILS runway two four. Be advised the runway is wet after heavy rain.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and tell him what you can do instead.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, reduce speed to one eight zero knots until one zero miles.

pre.text: Situation Update Passing one two thousand feet you get a TIRE PRESSURE LOW caption on the left main gear. Your brakes and anti-skid are normal, but with one wheel unserviceable **your required landing distance is now 3,100 metres.**

body.text: Report your problem to the controller, tell him what has changed, and make a request.
Rothbury / Caldon / landing distance available
Listen to the controller, state your decision with a reason, and tell him the figure you need.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Rothbury runway two four gives you 2,600 metres. Caldon has 3,400 metres and it's one four minutes away. What would you like?
Listen to the controller and provide the requested information.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, I'm passing it to Caldon. Say your fuel endurance and the number of persons on board.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback and say your intentions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn right heading three two zero, descend to 8,000 feet, vectors for Caldon, contact Caldon Approach on 126.35. Say your intentions.
You are now with a new controller who has none of your figures. Listen to him and answer both of his questions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Caldon Approach, radar contact. For our brief — say the landing distance you need, and say your fuel endurance.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and say what you will need on the runway.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn left heading two six zero, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway one eight approach, contact Caldon Tower on 120.9.

sections.title: 약점 D. 발신 — 기관 호출 · REQUEST + 명사구 — 실패율 64%

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In Part D **there is no controller transmission.** You call first. Each situation tells you what you want. Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 20 seconds or less

body.text: Caldon Control
Make a request with a reason.
Rothbury Delivery
Report your situation and make a request.

You were cleared to climb to one one thousand feet. By mistake you set nine thousand and you are now levelling off at nine thousand. No one has said anything to you. You want your climb back. Contact Minsterly Departure.
Report your status and make a request.
TAMLYN
Make a request with a reason.

Caldon Control has just cleared you to hold at OBREN as published, with no expected approach time, and you read it back. You have one hour one zero minutes of fuel and your diversion to Penhale needs three five minutes. You want to know when you can expect to leave the hold. Contact Caldon Control.
Report your status and make a request.

Ten minutes ago, on the taxi out, you saw fuel leaking from a parked Airbus A321 at stand two eight. You did not report it at the time. You want the ground controller to know now. Contact Rothbury Ground.
Make a report.

pre.text: ✅ Directions : You will be asked four questions. **You have up to 90 seconds for each.** Answer every part of the question.

body.text: Follow up question.

In this situation, you were given a runway that was shorter than the one you needed. What figures did you compare before you answered, and why? In your role as a pilot, how do you keep track of the numbers a controller gives you over a long approach — what do you write down, and how do you write it? Give an example of a figure you were asked for a second time and had to find again.
Follow up question.

In this situation, you were asked to hold a speed your aircraft could not hold. How did you tell the controller what you could do instead, and why does it matter that you gave him a figure? From your own experiences, how do you keep a minimum and a maximum from getting mixed up when both are in the same clearance? Give an example of a limit you have had to refuse.

How do you think the incident was handled by the air traffic controller? Do you feel the situation could have been handled differently? Make a comment from a pilot's point of view.
